description: issue #844: the EXECUTE-mode twin of geometry/check/arity-paren-axes-too-many. `axes` takes no arguments, so `(axes 50)` raises `ol-too-many-inputs` at `stage: "semantic"` with the same callable/expected/actual params and the same callee span the checker reports at `stage: "semantic"` — the two stages agreeing on one call. Issue #815: `execute()` now runs Layer 1 and Layer 2 before Phase 2 and refuses a program carrying an `error`-severity finding (`spec/execution-model.md:659-664`), so no event is emitted and the diagnostic delivered here is the CHECK's. The runtime's own copy of the rule still exists and still runs — under the `runUnchecked` opt-out — and is collapsed into the check's by the de-duplication rule (`spec/execution-model.md:741-748`), which is why only one report survives and it reads `stage: "semantic"`.
